name: Feasibility: Addons — stats and dashboards
description:
Owner per PRD: Addons team.

h2. Scope in PRD

- Downloads, ratings and usage rate per add-on
- Gives developers direct visibility into their performance without contacting the Addons team

h2. To analyse

- Where download / activation / rating data lives today and whether per-partner filtering is possible
- Freshness requirement: live query vs. periodic aggregation (Keboola / Power BI dataset)
- Data privacy — what an add-on developer may and may not see about merchants
- Relation to the metric "time from add-on release to first activation in an e-shop"

h2. Output

Systems involved, integration gaps, T-shirt size, blockers, MVP / later / out-of-scope recommendation.
